title: DAG Circuit Satisfiability and 3-SAT
statement: A bit string belongs to the language of encodings of fan-in-two satisfiable Boolean DAG circuits if and only if the bit string produced by converting its circuit-satisfiability CNF encoding to a bit string belongs to the language of satisfiable CNF formulas of width at most three.
